protocol.selectionCriterion: Compute per-family median relative loss reduction at final generation (g=2) of hereditary_reset vs fixed_reset (proposerImprovement) and vs each tuned conventional baseline (spsa, adam, bfgs). Rank candidates by compositeScore = 0.5 * min_family(medianProposerRelative) + 0.5 * min_{family,conv}(medianConvRelative). Deterministic tie-break: higher min_family(medianProposerRelative), then candidate declaration order.
